review_kind: Exact-source technical review; original and final independent semantic peers retained. No native-speaker claim.
review: Own-DINO names the user-trained DINO teacher classifier, not a downloaded foundation model. Incompatible settings/checkpoint/input refuse rather than silently fall back. Cancellation stops supervised classifier training; no scientific or resumable-training claim.
